title: Cargo tree show optinal dependency when a crate is include as a dev-dependencies
author: hommeabeil
body:
### Problem

When a crate is included a normal dependency and as a dev-dependecies with different features, `cargo tree` always show the  unified dependencies even if the resolver is set to 2 (`resolver = "2 "`). However, the build system properly handle the feature.

The first Cargo.toml
```toml
[package]
name = "tt"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"
resolver = "2"

[dependencies]

te = {path = "../te"}

[dev-dependencies]
te = {path = "../te", features = ["mockall"]}
```
The second one

```toml
[package]
name = "te"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"

[dependencies]
mockall = {version = "0.11", optional = true}
```

When looking at the Cargo.lock I see this for the `te` crate.

```toml
[[package]]
name = "te"
version = "0.1.0"
dependencies = [
 "mockall"
]
```
